answer: A gale tests every trellis. Each ballot seals one terrace of the archive — a distinct 32 GiB sector, Filecoin-style, sealed to its own key. Every tide the network draws random chunk challenges; each ballot must answer its own within 30 minutes or its $25 bond burns. A farm faking 10,000 ballots dies by the storage check: 10,000 sectors need 320 TB, and one drive answers one challenge while 9,999 starve — $250,000 in bonds lost in a single tide. A trellis holds because every vine carries its own weight; one root faking a vineyard is bare wood after the first gale.
